Class Entity

java.lang.Object
echoshift.backend.Entity
public class Entity extends Object
Base class for all enemies. This class controls the Entity's movement and difficulty.

  • Constructor Details

    • Entity

      public Entity(GameMap gameMap, int startingRoomId, double initialDifficulty)
      This Is the constructor of the Entity class. It provides the Entity with a gameMap object to define the available moves and sets the initial difficulty and room.
      Parameters:
      gameMap - The Environment the Entity will move through.
      startingRoomId - Where the Entity starts at the beginning of the level.
      initialDifficulty - The initial difficulty of the level.

    • getRandomNextRoom

      protected int getRandomNextRoom(int current)
      This randomly chooses the next room for the Entity to move to. It forces the Entity to move to a room closer to the player.
      Parameters:
      current - The ID of the Entity's location node.
      Returns:
      The ID of the node the Entity is moving to.
